summary: Retest of iteration-2 fixes for DaySync. Both fixes verified working. Backend: 21/21 pytest passed (test_daysync_auth.py) — including test_logo_upload_admin_and_serve which uploads a PNG and GETs the returned logo_url, confirming 200 image/* and URL built from PUBLIC_BASE_URL/EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Multi-tenant isolation, admin-only PATCH /api/company, invite rotation, visibility modes, tasks CRUD, employee join, and login all pass. Frontend: admin registration now correctly renders the invite-code screen (Company created + code 'RI08UTYC'/'FSRTIVXN' + Tap-to-copy + 'Continue to DaySync' testID=admin-continue). Tapping Continue calls refresh() which reads /api/auth/me, sets user in AuthContext, and RouteGuard navigates to /(tabs) Today screen. Regression tests confirmed navigation into Today tab after Continue. Sign-out flow via Profile tab reaches settings.tsx and the logout-btn is present; automated Alert.alert confirmation could not be fully clicked but the button is reachable. Employee-join UI regression could not be executed end-to-end via automation due to logout confirmation dialog, but backend fixture in test_daysync_auth.py exercises the full register-admin -> employee-join -> login path successfully every run. Both blocking issues from iteration 2 are RESOLVED.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks; migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, existing behavior fine).

ui_bugs.issue: RN Alert.alert renders as a custom modal on web; the confirmation 'Sign out' action wasn't reliably automatable via Playwright text click. Consider giving the confirmation button an explicit testID (e.g. 'logout-confirm-btn') so QA scripts can complete the flow.

issues: Deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking, RN-Web only.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='logout-confirm-btn' to the Alert.alert confirmation button in settings.tsx so end-to-end automation can complete Sign out -> welcome verification.
Optional: silence 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:36-40 correctly prefers PUBLIC_BASE_URL, falls back to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, with request.base_url as last-resort fallback in upload_logo — good defensive layering.
AuthContext.signUpAdmin now uses persistTokenOnly, so user state is not set until the caller calls refresh() from the invite screen's Continue button — correctly decouples registration from routing.

RouteGuard useEffect in _layout.tsx only redirects on [user, loading, segments] change; since user stays null after signUpAdmin, register-admin.tsx keeps rendering setStep('invite') until refresh() is called on Continue.
Multi-tenant isolation via company_id filter on every events/tasks query — verified by test_event_isolation_get/patch/delete/list.
PATCH /api/company gated by require_admin dependency; employee correctly gets 403 (test_patch_company_employee_forbidden).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (Fix 1 verified end-to-end; Sign-out confirmation modal not automatable but button is present and reachable)

seed_data_creation: Tests create their own TEST_ prefixed companies+users each run; UI test created admin_<ts>@example.com / Password123! with company TEST_RetestCo (invite code varies per run, e.g. RI08UTYC).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration-2 blocking bugs (invite-screen preemption + logo URL) are fixed and verified. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_daysync_auth.py is stable — run `pytest tests/test_daysync_auth.py -v` from /app/backend. Frontend flow: welcome -> welcome-create-company -> fill admin-{company-name,name,email,password} -> admin-submit -> invite screen with admin-continue testID -> Continue routes to (tabs)/Today. Header 'Profile' text or header-profile-btn routes to /settings which contains logout-btn (Alert.alert confirmation on web has no testID). Employee join CTA on welcome is 'I have an invite code' text; join screen inputs are join-code/join-name/join-email/join-password/join-submit — confirmed via backend fixture that the flow works end-to-end.
rca_of_issue: Iteration-2 RCA summary (both fixed): (1) signUpAdmin was calling persist(token, user) which set user in AuthProvider, triggering RouteGuard to replace() to /(tabs) before setStep('invite') could render — fix decouples token persistence (persistTokenOnly) from user activation (refresh() on Continue). Verified: invite-code screen mounts, admin-continue testID is present, code is displayed, tapping Continue routes to Today tab. (2) upload_logo used FastAPI request.base_url which resolves to the internal cluster host (blocked by Cloudflare) — fix reads PUBLIC_BASE_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from backend/.env. Verified: PUT PNG -> returned logo_url starts with https://gpt-cross-platform.preview.emergentagent.com/api/files/... -> GET returns 200 with image content-type.
